title: ego lite: A Browser Where You and AI Agents Work in Parallel
description:
ego lite is a free, open-source browser designed for you and your AI agents to share. Agents run tasks in their own Spaces while your tabs stay yours. It inherits Chrome logins, runs tasks up to 2.5x faster, and works with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
